xref.title: Jeff Martin's Solo Career and Production Work
xref.body: After The Tea Party's initial breakup, Jeff Martin moved to Ireland to launch a solo career. He subsequently formed the bands The Armada and Jeff Martin 777, and also worked as a producer for various artists. "Jeff moved to Ireland to start a solo career then came a band called the Armada followed by Jeff Martin 777 and he also served as a producer for a number of acts."
